overview:
Josh Gottheimer seeks another term in a northern New Jersey district that leans slightly Democratic. He enters the general election with an overwhelming financial advantage, having raised about $4.8 million and holding $12.8 million on hand, while Republican Sean Kirrane has raised only about $56,000. Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket give Gottheimer a 93-95% chance of winning.

No public general-election polls or expert race ratings are available, so the outlook rests on fundamentals, money, and market pricing. Those all point the same way: an incumbent in a favorable district facing a severely underfunded challenger. The race is rated Safe D, with modest uncertainty given the lack of direct polling.
